span.p:
8. Review and publish results
Compliance reviewers and Assessment service
Reviewers resolve PENDING_REVIEW items. The completed assessment is published as OSCAL assessment results, and Project 3 is notified.

span.p:
7. Validate evidence against controls
Assessment validation engine (AI-assisted)
Deterministic rules test evidence against each control's criteria. AI flags ambiguous cases. Results: PASSED, FAILED, PENDING_REVIEW.

span.p:
6. Collect the evidence
Evidence engine (AI-assisted)
Uses connectors to retrieve evidence; AI helps with unstructured sources. Files go to S3 with a hash and statuses become COLLECTED.

span.p:
5. Create evidence requests
Evidence collection service
Consumes the event, creates evidence entities (metadata) in REQUESTED status, and publishes EvidenceRequested.

4. Start an assessment
Assessment service
A schedule or a reviewer starts a run. The service creates assessments for ACTIVE configs and publishes AssessmentCreated.

3. Configure controls and connectors
Compliance reviewers in the Admin console
Reviewers select the connector each control needs. If it is PENDING, they provide its settings. The control config then becomes ACTIVE.

span.p:
2. Create control configurations
Catalog ingestion service
Creates a configuration for each control in the catalog through the Control config API, in PENDING status.

span.p:
1. Ingest the published catalog
Catalog ingestion service
Retrieves each approved OSCAL catalog from the Project 1 Catalog service, through an internal API, when a new version is published.
